Generate Python code based on the following instruction. Output ONLY code. DO NOT include explanations or other textual content.
Instruction: Generate code that creates a project in Maxwell 2D using the PyAEDT library and runs a transient simulation. The code should import necessary libraries, set non-graphical mode, insert a Maxwell 2D design and save the project. It should create a rectangle and duplicate it, create an air region, assign windings to the sheets and a balloon to the air region, and plot the model. The code should also create a transient setup, create a rectangular plot, solve the model, create output and plot it using PyVista, generate the same plot outside AEDT, and finally close AEDT.

```python
from pyaedt import Maxwell2d
from pyaedt import generate_unique_project_name
import os

# Set non-graphical mode
nongraphical = True

# Launch Maxwell 2D in non-graphical mode and create a new project
project_name = generate_unique_project_name("Maxwell2D_Transient")
maxwell2d = Maxwell2d(projectname=project_name, specified_version="2024.1", non_graphical=nongraphical, new_desktop_session=True)

# Insert a new Maxwell 2D design
design_name = "TransientDesign"
maxwell2d.insert_design(design_name, solution_type="Transient")

# Create a rectangle
rect1 = maxwell2d.modeler.create_rectangle(position=[0, 0], dimension_list=[10, 5], name="Rect1", matname="copper", is_covered=True)

# Duplicate the rectangle
rect2 = maxwell2d.modeler.duplicate(rect1, offset=[12, 0, 0])[0]
maxwell2d.modeler.rename_object(rect2, "Rect2")

# Create an air region
maxwell2d.modeler.create_air_region(x_pos=20, y_pos=20, x_neg=20, y_neg=20, z_pos=0, z_neg=0)

# Assign windings to the sheets
maxwell2d.assign_winding(rect1, winding_type="Current", current_value=1, name="Winding1")
maxwell2d.assign_winding("Rect2", winding_type="Current", current_value=-1, name="Winding2")

# Assign balloon boundary to the air region
air_region = [obj for obj in maxwell2d.modeler.object_names if "Region" in obj][0]
maxwell2d.assign_balloon(air_region)

# Plot the model
maxwell2d.plot(show=False, export_path=os.path.join(maxwell2d.working_directory, "model_plot.png"))

# Create a transient setup
setup = maxwell2d.create_setup("TransientSetup")
setup.props["StopTime"] = "10ms"
setup.props["TimeStep"] = "0.1ms"
setup.update()

# Create a rectangular plot (field plot)
fieldplot = maxwell2d.post.create_fieldplot_surface([rect1, "Rect2"], quantity_name="Mag_B", setup_name="TransientSetup", intrinsic_dict={"Time": "5ms"})

# Solve the model
maxwell2d.analyze_setup("TransientSetup")

# Create output and plot it using PyVista
plot_obj = maxwell2d.post.plot_field(fieldplot, plot_type="mag", show=False, export_path=os.path.join(maxwell2d.working_directory, "field_plot_pyvista.png"))

# Generate the same plot outside AEDT using PyVista
import pyvista as pv
mesh = maxwell2d.post.get_solution_data_per_object("Mag_B", object_list=[rect1, "Rect2"], setup_sweep_name="TransientSetup : LastAdaptive")
grid = pv.StructuredGrid()
grid.points = mesh.points
grid["Mag_B"] = mesh.data_real()
plotter = pv.Plotter(off_screen=True)
plotter.add_mesh(grid, scalars="Mag_B", cmap="viridis")
plotter.screenshot(os.path.join(maxwell2d.working_directory, "field_plot_external.png"))
plotter.close()

# Save the project
maxwell2d.save_project()

# Close AEDT
maxwell2d.close_desktop()
```
